title: Intersectional Inquiry, on the Ground and in the Algorithm

bias_targets.methodology: Generating sentences from language models (GPT-2 and GPT-NEO) using prompts containing disability markers, then evaluating the outputs using an automated sentiment analysis algorithm and topic modeling.

Generating sentences from language models using prompts containing religious markers (e.g., Muslim, Buddhist), followed by evaluation using sentiment analysis and topic modeling to identify negative or stereotypical associations.
Generating sentences from language models using prompts containing gender markers, then evaluating the predicted text using sentiment analysis and topic modeling.

Inputting 280 possible combinations of disability, religion, and gender terms into language models and evaluating the compounded bias in the generated text using sentiment analysis scores and topic modeling.

Qualitative evaluation through community scoping workshops and focus groups with culturally and linguistically diverse parent carers to assess representational exclusion and varying cultural metaphors (e.g., the Doraemon care robot) in AI design.
